automaticTikTokCatalog.retrievalMethod: Pagination of TikTok public creator/item_list responses, without authentication or cookies; media downloaded on demand from validated public CDN sources.
automaticTikTokCatalog.snapshotScope: Public listing observed during retrieval research. Counts can change. This is not a completed v0.6 build/playback test, and these posts are not all prebundled media files.
automaticTikTokCatalog.cache: Application.persistentDataPath/TikTok; catalog.json stores runtime provenance and media/ stores on-demand files. Media uses a 2147483648-byte soft limit with recent/in-flight protection.
automaticTikTokCatalog.limitations: The undocumented public endpoint can change or become unavailable. Partial/offline refreshes preserve prior catalogue entries. No authentication or access to private/deleted posts is provided. Three shipped archives remain fallback media.
